description:
No exit primitive exists in runtime/src. Drivers return to the CLI which calls exit (cli.rs:48-63); AOT fz_aot_run_main returns 0/1 (runtime/src/aot_shim.rs:617-623). System.halt(n) must stop the scheduler, flush stdout (Rust LineWriter is not flushed by process::exit), and exit with n. Used by the distiller's check! on a census mismatch.

## Design review (2026-10-17)
Fold: a fault and a halt are both 'the root process ended with a status'. One ExitStatus (normal / halt(n) / fault(reason)) replaces Process.exit_fault (12 uses in src and runtime) and is read once by each driver; cli.rs maps it to the process exit code. main's discarded return value stays discarded (Elixir scripts exit 0).
title: System.halt/1 sets the exit status on all three paths
